summary_en: The caller initiated the call to inquire about the pricing of a 3-kilowatt system. The agent shared the total cost, government subsidy, and EMI options. The caller initially objected, stating the price was too expensive, but after the agent reiterated the subsidy and EMI details, the caller requested the monthly EMI amount again. Upon confirmation of the 48-month EMI starting at 2,999 rupees, the caller agreed to a free site survey. The caller provided their name as Kiran, their location as Velachery, and requested the survey on Saturday. The agent recorded the details and promised that the team would contact the caller to arrange the Saturday survey.
next_action: Agent to contact the caller to schedule the free site survey on Saturday.
